description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Outings: recreation forests (자연휴양림) with the shared national reservation calendar, public campgrounds, highway rest areas (휴게소) by route and direction with menu price ranges, and public leisure sports (승마 · 클라이밍 · 활쏘기 · 스케이트 · 사격). With no inputs: the kinds in this group, what each answers, and the conditions it can be narrowed by. With a kind: a nationwide summary of that kind. With a region, conditions or words: matching places (default 10), each with an id for get_place, a one-line summary and the page URL. Results are in Korean.

direction.description: Rest areas only: direction as 상행 / 하행 or a destination such as "부산", "서울". 방향.

filters.description: Optional condition keys, all must hold. Valid keys per kind are listed in the result `next.filters` (e.g. free, walkin, indoor, pets, monday). 조건.

from.description: Optional offset to continue a list (`nextFrom` from the previous result).

kind.description: foresttrip (휴양림), camping (공공 캠핑장), reststop (고속도로 휴게소), leisure (레포츠 체험).

limit.description: Optional number of places to return, default 10, max 30.

menu.description: Rest areas only: a dish name in Korean to compare prices across rest areas, e.g. "우동", "돈가스". 메뉴.

query.description: Optional words to match against place names and addresses, in Korean, e.g. "장충", "글로벌도서관". 이름 · 주소 낱말.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

route.description: Rest areas only: Korean highway route name, e.g. "경부선", "영동선". 노선.

name: explore_outings
title: 나들이 갈 곳 찾기
